products.title: Alstroemeria
products.description: Also called Peruvian Lily or Lily of the Incas, alstroemeria produces vibrant, long-lasting blooms with characteristic streaked inner petals. Native to South America, it symbolizes friendship and devotion.

symbolism.origin: The leaves twist as they grow outward, symbolizing the trials, turns, and steadfast support found in a true friendship.

products.title: Alyssum
products.description: Sweet alyssum is a delicate annual ground cover producing masses of tiny, honey-scented white or pink flowers. Native to the Mediterranean, it blooms prolifically and attracts beneficial insects like bees and butterflies.

symbolism.origin: Named 'sweet alyssum' for its honey-like fragrance; Victorians saw its modest, low-growing form as representing worth that surpasses outward appearance.

products.title: Aster
products.description: Asters are daisy-like perennials blooming in late summer and autumn in shades of purple, pink, blue, and white. They are an essential late-season source of nectar for pollinators and add color to the autumn garden.

symbolism.origin: Its slender petals surrounding a small center inspired delicacy and refinement.

products.title: Azelea
products.description: Azalea is a flowering shrub prized for its spectacular spring display of large, showy blooms. It prefers acidic soil and partial shade, and is a staple of cottage and Japanese-style gardens.

symbolism.origin: Azaleas are short-lived and sensitive to excess water, symbolizing fragility and restraint.

products.title: Baby Sun Rose
products.description: Low-growing succulent with bright pink flowers. Excellent groundcover for sunny spots. Drought tolerant and heat loving.

symbolism.origin: Its bright, cheerful blooms and sun-loving nature symbolize warmth and joy.

products.title: Baby’s Breath
products.description: Baby's breath (Gypsophila) produces clouds of tiny, delicate white or pink flowers on wiry branching stems. A staple of the florist's art, it is used to add lightness and texture to bouquets and arrangements.

symbolism.origin: Named in the 19th century for its delicate scent and bridal-veil appearance.

products.title: Balsam
products.description: Garden balsam (Impatiens balsamina) is an old-fashioned annual with cup-shaped, camellia-like flowers nestled among lance-shaped leaves. It thrives in warm, humid conditions and is beloved for its ease of care.

symbolism.origin: Ripe seed pods burst open at the slightest touch, giving rise to the genus name Impatiens and a Victorian symbol of restless ardor.

products.title: Begonia
products.description: Begonias are versatile flowering plants prized for their colorful blooms and attractive foliage. Available in hundreds of varieties, they are ideal for shade gardens, hanging baskets, and containers, blooming from spring to frost.

symbolism.origin: Named after Michel Bégon; its sound-alike phrase “be gone” suggested caution.

products.title: Bougainvillea
products.description: Vibrant tropical vine with colorful papery bracts. Produces stunning cascades of pink, purple, orange, or red. Thrives in warm, sunny spots.

products.title: Butterfly Weed
products.description: Butterfly weed (Asclepias tuberosa) is a bright North American wildflower producing dense clusters of vibrant orange, yellow, or red flowers. A critical host plant for monarch butterfly caterpillars, it is essential for pollinator gardens.

symbolism.origin: Vital role in butterfly life cycles symbolizes transformation and resilience.

products.title: Calendula
products.description: Calendula, or pot marigold, is a bright annual with cheerful orange and yellow daisy-like flowers. Its petals are edible and have been used medicinally since ancient times for their anti-inflammatory and skin-healing properties.

symbolism.origin: Flowers open and close faithfully with the sun each day; Victorians associated this constancy with grief borne quietly and sacred affection.

products.title: California Poppy
products.description: The California poppy is the state flower of California, producing silky, cup-shaped blooms in shades of orange, yellow, and cream. It is drought-tolerant, self-seeding, and thrives in poor, well-drained soils.

symbolism.origin: Its brilliant golden petals, glowing like sunlight across the hills, evoked visions of wealth and the promise of good fortune.

products.title: Calla Lily
products.description: Calla lily (Zantedeschia) is renowned for its elegant, trumpet-shaped spathe and glossy arrow-shaped leaves. A favorite in bridal bouquets and ornamental gardens, it conveys purity and magnificent beauty.

symbolism.origin: Its pure white spathe and flawless, sculpted form made it a symbol of regal magnificence in Victorian parlors and bridal ceremonies.

products.title: Carnation
products.description: Carnations (Dianthus caryophyllus) are among the oldest cultivated flowers, prized for their spicy, clove-like fragrance and ruffled, fringed petals. They symbolize love and fascination and come in virtually every color.

symbolism.origin: Linked to the Virgin Mary’s tears at Christ’s crucifixion.

products.title: Chrysanthemum
products.description: Chrysanthemums, or mums, are the quintessential autumn flower, producing dense pompom or daisy-like blooms in a vast spectrum of colors. In East Asian cultures they symbolize longevity and rejuvenation.

symbolism.origin: Commonly used in European funerals and All Souls’ Day rituals.

products.title: Cockscomb (Mawal)
products.description: Cockscomb (Celosia argentea var. cristata) is a striking annual with velvety, crested flower heads resembling a rooster's comb. It thrives in warm climates and adds bold color to gardens and floral arrangements.

symbolism.origin: Its flamboyant crest and vibrant colors made it a Victorian emblem of boldness and daring.

products.title: Cornflower
products.description: Cornflowers (Centaurea cyanus) are annual wildflowers producing intense sky-blue, purple, pink, or white flowers. Once common in European grain fields, they are now valued as cottage garden plants and cut flowers.

symbolism.origin: Folklore claimed its longevity predicted whether love would be returned.

products.title: Cosmos
products.description: Cosmos are graceful annuals producing delicate, daisy-like flowers on airy stems in shades of pink, red, orange, purple, and white. Heat and drought tolerant, they bloom prolifically from summer until frost.

symbolism.origin: The name means 'harmony' and 'order' from the Greek, reflecting its perfect symmetry.

products.title: Daffodil
products.description: Daffodils (Narcissus) are iconic spring bulbs bearing cheerful yellow or white trumpet-shaped flowers. They are among the first flowers to bloom after winter and are toxic to most animals, deterring pests naturally.

symbolism.origin: From the myth of Narcissus falling in love with his reflection.

products.title: Dahlia
products.description: Dahlias are tuberous perennials native to Mexico and Central America, producing showy blooms in an astonishing variety of forms and colors from midsummer until frost. They were once prized as a food source by the Aztecs.

symbolism.origin: Long-lasting blooms made it a Victorian wedding symbol.

products.title: Daisy
products.description: The classic garden daisy features pristine white ray petals surrounding a bright yellow disc center. Simple and cheerful, it has appeared in mythology and literature across cultures as a symbol of innocence and new beginnings.

symbolism.origin: Appears in Norse, Celtic, and Roman mythology as a symbol of innocence.

products.title: Damask Rose
products.description: The Damask rose (Rosa damascena) is a legendary ancient rose originating in the Middle East, famed for its intensely rich fragrance. It is the primary source of rose water and rose attar used in perfumery worldwide.

symbolism.origin: Brought to Europe by Crusaders from Damascus; its intoxicating fragrance and layered petals became synonymous with timeless, devoted love.

products.title: Dianthus
products.description: Dianthus, commonly called pinks, are fragrant perennial or annual flowers with fringed, tooth-edged petals in shades of pink, red, and white. The name means "flower of the gods" in Greek.

symbolism.origin: The name means 'flower of the gods' in Greek; Victorians used it to express a love that was both divine and boldly declared.

products.title: Fuchsia
products.description: Elegant plant with tubular flowers in contrasting colors. Graceful pendant blooms attract hummingbirds. Prefers cool, shaded locations.

products.title: Geranium
products.description: Garden geraniums (Pelargonium) are among the most popular container and bedding plants worldwide, valued for their bright flower clusters, attractive leaves, and robust nature. They thrive in sunny spots with well-drained soil.

symbolism.origin: The showy scarlet blooms were considered deceptively simple; Victorians used it to gently signal folly or a lack of depth.

products.title: Gerbera Daisy
products.description: Large, vibrant daisy-like flowers in bold colors. Cheerful blooms on long stems. Popular as ornamental plant and cut flower.

products.title: Ghazania
products.description: Vibrant daisy-like flowers in orange, red, or yellow with distinctive striped patterns. Sun-loving annual or perennial groundcover.

products.title: Gladiolus
products.description: Gladiolus produces dramatic tall spikes of large, funnel-shaped flowers in nearly every color. Originally from South Africa, the corms are planted in spring for summer blooms that are spectacular as cut flowers.

symbolism.origin: From *gladius*, Latin for sword.

products.title: Godetia
products.description: Godetia (Clarkia amoena), also known as Farewell-to-Spring, is a Western North American wildflower producing large, silky, cup-shaped blooms in shades of pink, red, lavender, and white. It prefers cool weather.

symbolism.origin: Called Farewell-to-Spring for its late blooming; its vivid, fleeting flowers inspired a Victorian sense of being utterly captivated.

products.title: Hollyhock
products.description: Hollyhocks are stately biennials or perennials that send up towering spikes of large, single or double flowers in a wide range of colors. A cottage garden classic, they often self-seed freely along walls and fences.

symbolism.origin: Its towering spikes reaching skyward above garden walls inspired Victorians to see it as the emblem of lofty ambition and fertile abundance.

products.title: Hyacinth
products.description: Hyacinths are spring-blooming bulbs renowned for their intensely sweet, heady fragrance and dense racemes of small, star-shaped flowers. They are perfect for forcing indoors in winter for early color and scent.

symbolism.origin: From Apollo’s grief over Hyacinthus in Greek myth.

products.title: Hydrangea
products.description: Hydrangeas are magnificent flowering shrubs producing enormous, dome-shaped or lacecap flower heads in shades of blue, pink, white, and purple. The flower color of some varieties is influenced by soil pH, turning blue in acidic soils.

symbolism.origin: Large blooms with few seeds suggested excess show.

products.title: Iris
products.description: Irises are elegant perennials with distinctive sword-like foliage and intricate, bearded or beardless flowers. Named after the Greek goddess of the rainbow, they come in virtually every color and combination.

symbolism.origin: Symbol of victory in Egyptian and Frankish history.

products.title: Jasmine
products.description: Jasmine is a climbing or shrubby plant producing clusters of small, intensely fragrant white or yellow flowers. Widely used in garlands, tea, and perfumery across Asia, it is a symbol of amiability and grace.

symbolism.origin: Celebratory flower in many Asian cultures.

products.title: Larkspur
products.description: Larkspur (Delphinium consolida) is an annual producing tall, graceful spikes of spurred flowers in shades of blue, purple, pink, and white. A classic cottage garden and cutting garden annual, it dries beautifully for arrangements.

symbolism.origin: Named for a lark’s foot; associated with lightness.

products.title: Lavender
products.description: Lavender is an aromatic Mediterranean shrub producing spikes of small purple flowers beloved by pollinators. Its dried flowers and essential oil are used extensively in aromatherapy, cosmetics, and culinary applications.

symbolism.origin: Linked to venomous snakes and Cleopatra’s legend.

products.title: Lilac
products.description: Lilacs are deciduous shrubs or small trees that produce spectacular clusters of intensely fragrant flowers in spring. Hardy and long-lived, they are a cherished feature of temperate gardens and a symbol of first love.

symbolism.origin: Greek myth of Pan and Syringa.

products.title: Lily
products.description: True lilies are stately bulbous perennials producing large, often fragrant trumpet or turks cap flowers on tall stems. They come in a spectacular range of colors and are among the most beloved of all garden flowers.

symbolism.origin: Associated with the Virgin Mary in Christian art.

products.title: Marigold
products.description: Marigolds are cheerful, sun-loving annuals producing bold pompom flowers in shades of orange, yellow, and gold. Easy to grow and prolific, they are widely used as companion plants to deter garden pests.

symbolism.origin: Used in Day of the Dead rituals and Aztec lore.

products.title: Miniature Rose
products.description: Miniature roses are petite versions of classic roses with tiny, intricately formed blooms. Perfect for containers, bonsai, and compact spaces, they come in all rose colors and bloom prolifically.

products.title: Morning Glory
products.description: Morning glories are fast-growing annual vines producing a profusion of trumpet-shaped flowers that open fresh each morning. Their vibrant blooms in blue, purple, pink, and white make them ideal for fences and trellises.

symbolism.origin: Flowers bloom brilliantly each morning only to close by afternoon; Victorians read this as a token of fleeting affection and love in vain.

products.title: Nerium Oleander
products.description: Nerium oleander is a beautiful, fast-growing Mediterranean shrub producing clusters of fragrant flowers in shades of pink, red, and white throughout summer. Highly ornamental but extremely toxic in all its parts.

symbolism.origin: Poisonous plant linked to tragic Greek myth.

products.title: Pansy
products.description: Pansies are charming cool-weather annuals with distinctive "face" markings on their velvety petals. Available in an extraordinary range of colors and bi-colors, they are a beloved staple of spring and autumn gardens.

symbolism.origin: From the French *pensée*, meaning thought.

products.title: Peony
products.description: Peonies are long-lived herbaceous perennials producing enormous, luxuriously fragrant blooms in shades of white, pink, and red. Among the most cherished of all garden flowers, they can live and bloom for over a century.

symbolism.origin: Greek nymphs hid by transforming into peonies.

products.title: Periwinkle (Vinca)
products.description: Periwinkle is a low-maintenance evergreen ground cover or trailing plant with glossy dark green leaves and cheerful five-petaled flowers in blue, violet, or white. It thrives in sun or shade with minimal care.

symbolism.origin: Evergreen and enduring, its small persistent flowers were treasured by Victorians as an emblem of cherished memories and tender recollection.

products.title: Petunia
products.description: Petunias are among the most popular summer bedding plants, producing masses of trumpet-shaped flowers in every color of the rainbow throughout the season. Available in trailing and upright forms, they are superb in containers.

symbolism.origin: Delicate nature likened to wounded emotions.

products.title: Phlox
products.description: Phlox is a North American native producing masses of star-shaped, fragrant flowers in a wide range of colors. Garden phlox is a cottage garden staple, while creeping phlox creates a carpet of spring color.

symbolism.origin: Dense clusters of individual flowers growing as one mass symbolized hearts united and complete unanimity of feeling.

products.title: Pink Rose
products.description: The traditional Kashmiri pink rose is a heritage variety prized for its full, fragrant blooms in delicate shades of pink. Grown in the famous rose gardens of Kashmir, it is used for rose water and as an ornamental.

symbolism.origin: Long-standing symbol of love in myth and culture.

products.title: Primrose
products.description: Primroses (Primula) are charming spring-flowering perennials producing clusters of bright, cheerful blooms in shades of yellow, red, pink, purple, and white. They thrive in cool, moist soil and partial shade.

symbolism.origin: Among the first flowers to bloom in spring, symbolizing youth and new beginnings.

products.title: Snowball (Guelder Rose)
products.description: Deciduous shrub with spectacular white snowball-like flower clusters. Stunning spring display followed by red berries. Classic cottage garden plant.

products.title: Stocks
products.description: Stocks (Matthiola incana) are old-fashioned annuals or biennials producing tall spikes of densely packed, intensely fragrant flowers in shades of pink, white, red, and purple. Their sweet scent fills gardens in spring.

symbolism.origin: Long-lasting blooms and an enduring sweet fragrance led Victorians to see it as a symbol of a life lived in contented, lasting beauty.

products.title: Sunflower
products.description: Sunflowers are iconic annual plants native to North America, growing tall with large, golden ray flowers surrounding a central disc. They track the sun when young and produce nutritious seeds loved by birds and humans.

symbolism.origin: Inca gold symbolism misled Spanish explorers.

products.title: Sweet William
products.description: Sweet William (Dianthus barbatus) is a biennial or short-lived perennial producing dense, domed clusters of small, fragrant flowers in striking patterns of red, pink, white, and bicolors. A cottage garden classic.

symbolism.origin: Named for folkloric gallant young men.

products.title: Tiger Lily
products.description: Tiger lilies (Lilium lancifolium) are exotic perennial bulbs producing nodding turks-cap flowers with distinctive black or dark spots. Hardy, vigorous, and striking, they add drama to any garden.

symbolism.origin: Named for distinctive spotted markings resembling tiger stripes

products.title: Tulip
products.description: Tulips are beloved spring-blooming bulbs native to Central Asia, producing elegant cup-shaped flowers in virtually every color of the spectrum. They were the subject of the famous 17th-century Dutch Tulipmania speculation.

symbolism.origin: Turkish legend of tragic devotion.
meanings: I declare my love for you

products.title: Verbena
products.description: Verbena is a sun-loving annual or perennial producing clusters of small, brightly colored flowers in shades of purple, pink, red, and white. Long-blooming and heat-tolerant, it is excellent for containers and hanging baskets.

symbolism.origin: Revered in Druidic and Roman sacred rites; Victorians regarded it as a charm of enchantment and a sincere plea for wishes to be granted.

products.title: Yarrow
products.description: Yarrow (Achillea millefolium) is a robust perennial wildflower with feathery aromatic leaves and flat-topped clusters of tiny flowers in white, yellow, pink, or red. Named after Achilles, who is said to have used it to heal wounds.

symbolism.origin: Named after Achilles, who healed wounds with it.

products.title: Zinnia
products.description: Zinnias are vibrant, heat-loving annuals native to Mexico, producing bold daisy-like flowers in every color except blue. Easy to grow from seed and highly attractive to butterflies, they bloom continuously from summer to frost.

symbolism.origin: Easy growth and reseeding symbolized lasting bonds.
